name: DAS KARTELL — Profit Basetool Design System

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: HAUSFARBE (website orange of das-kartell.org). Filled CTA (.btn--cta), headings, links, focus rings, HUD brackets, the 2px header/table-head rule. Text on it is always dark (#000 8.8:1); white reaches only 2.4:1 and is not allowed.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: WEISS. Data readouts (--data-fg), selected-control text, text on danger/success fills.

tokens.name: color-bg-black
tokens.usage: SCHWARZ. Text on orange and on light status fills, shadows. Not a page background (that is color-canvas).

tokens.name: color-canvas
tokens.usage: CANVAS. Page background, page head, boxes set into a panel (surface-inset).

tokens.name: color-accent-light
tokens.usage: ZIERFARBE HELL. Hover state of every orange element; active segment count; 6.3:1 on the panel.

tokens.name: color-accent-dark
tokens.usage: ZIERFARBE DUNKEL. Admin chrome (admin-mode header rule, admin chip border), deep accents. Not for text.

tokens.name: color-gray-1
tokens.usage: GRAU 1 / TEXT. Body text, labels, table text: 11.8:1 on canvas, 8.4:1 on panel, 6.8:1 on control.

tokens.name: color-gray-2
tokens.usage: GRAU 2 / CONTROL BORDER. Border of every control (3.8:1 on panel, 5.3:1 on canvas), scrollbar thumb, status dots. Never as text: use color-gray-2-text.

tokens.name: color-gray-3
tokens.usage: GRAU 3 / HAIRLINE. Decoration only: row dividers, panel frames; .btn-secondary fill. Never a control border.

tokens.name: color-gray-4
tokens.usage: GRAU 4 / PANEL. Standard surface: cards, tables, .list-panel, modals, sidebar, toasts.

tokens.name: color-bg-dark-gray
tokens.usage: Alias of Grau 4 (panel) used throughout the component CSS.

tokens.name: color-surface-input
tokens.usage: BAR. Header, footer, tab bar, table head, inset fields (code, meters, facts bar). Controls use control-bg.

tokens.name: color-control
tokens.usage: CONTROL. Resting fill of every non-CTA control; table-row hover.

tokens.name: color-control-hover
tokens.usage: CONTROL HOVER. Hover fill of controls and segments. Muted text on it reaches only 3.7:1 — hovered controls use Grau 1 or white text.

tokens.name: color-count-badge
tokens.usage: COUNT BADGE. Title counter (.count-badge), white digits 10:1.

tokens.name: color-dept-raumueberlegenheit
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Raumüberlegenheit (Space Superiority). Department tags/rows only; value must not be altered. Tags are filled (black text).

tokens.name: color-dept-forschung
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Forschung (Research). Department tags/rows only; value must not be altered. Too dark for text on gray surfaces — tags are filled (.dept-tag--forschung, white text).

tokens.name: color-dept-sub-radar
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Sub-Radar. Department tags/rows only; value must not be altered. Never as text — tags are filled (.dept-tag--sub-radar, white text).

tokens.name: color-dept-marinekorps
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Marinekorps (Marine Corps). Department tags/rows only; value must not be altered. Tags are filled (white text).

tokens.name: color-dept-profit
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Profit. Department tags/rows only; value must not be altered. Tags are filled (black text).

tokens.name: color-dept-search-rescue
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Search and Rescue. Department tags/rows only; value must not be altered. Tags are filled (black text).

tokens.name: color-dept-combat
tokens.usage: Alias of Raumüberlegenheit (code name "combat"). Prefer the official name.

tokens.name: color-dept-research
tokens.usage: Alias of Forschung. Prefer the official name.

tokens.name: color-dept-marine
tokens.usage: Alias of Marinekorps. Prefer the official name.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Danger fill/border (same value as Sub-Radar): .btn-danger fill with white text, alert/chip borders. As text use color-danger-text.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success fill/border (same value as Profit): .btn-success fill with white text, alert borders, status dots.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning (same value as Search and Rescue): alert borders, in-progress status text (8.1:1 on panel).

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Info fill/border (same value as Forschung). As text use color-info-text.

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Cross-squadron / foreign-link highlight (.squadron-badge-foreign).

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Filled CTA colour: the ONE primary action per context.

tokens.name: action-emphasis
tokens.usage: Outline secondary (.btn-outline).

tokens.name: action-neutral
tokens.usage: Ghost border: Grau 2, so the boundary reaches 3:1.

tokens.name: data-fg
tokens.usage: Bright neutral data readouts (.data-value, kv values, facts bar). Orange is never a data colour.

tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: Surface ladder step 0: page background.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Surface ladder step 1: the .list-panel work surface grouping toolbar, table and footer.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: A box set into a panel (HUD box, module tile).

tokens.name: surface-bar
tokens.usage: Bars: header, footer, tab bar, table head.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: .btn-secondary fill.

tokens.name: control-bg
tokens.usage: Resting fill of every non-CTA control (ghost, quiet-danger, segment, pagination, inputs, selects, switch).

tokens.name: control-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of controls.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Border of every non-CTA control: ≥3:1 on canvas and panel (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: control-fg
tokens.usage: Control label text, 6.8:1 on control-bg.

tokens.name: control-selected-bg
tokens.usage: Selected segment / view switch: orange tint (≈#615346 on control-bg), never a solid orange block.

tokens.name: control-selected-border
tokens.usage: Selected segment border + 3px underline (the non-colour cue).

tokens.name: control-selected-fg
tokens.usage: Selected segment text, 7.4:1 on control-selected-bg.

tokens.name: color-danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of .btn-danger.

tokens.name: color-success-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of .btn-success.
